data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gains. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each person: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
